Chaos game with SVD-described maps, instanced on the GPU

Two maps, each pivoted on its own centre c with its linear part written as an SVD, A = T(c) · R(u) · diag(s0, s1) · R(−v) · T(−c), with 0 < si < 1 so the maps contract. The chaos game runs once on the CPU; the GPU then draws those points for each of 2n instances, instance 0110 using T0·T1·T1·T0. Switch on Explore to let centres, rotations and scales wander.
